idea-plugin.name: React Native Workbench
idea-plugin.description:
Run, inspect and stop React Native development sessions from one IDE workbench.

  • Separate consoles for Metro, Android, iOS and release builds.
  • Device and simulator selection, environment profiles and custom app directories for monorepos.
  • Metro cache reset, environment diagnostics, exit codes and actionable launch errors.
  • Compact theme-aware icon toolbar, responsive overflow menu and automatic app discovery.

Requires Node.js and project-local React Native CLI dependencies. Android requires an Android SDK; iOS requires macOS and Xcode. This workbench runs CLI commands; it does not provide a JavaScript breakpoint debugger.

Maintained by senjucao, based on the Apache-2.0 React Native Companion project.
